verdict.rationale: The evidence pack documents no first-party dataset curation feature and no offline evaluation runs against curated datasets. The nearest items do not qualify: a community user exporting requests to build a fine-tuning dataset is a user-side workaround, webhook-driven 'real-time evaluation' is online scoring through external systems rather than offline evals, and the Playground covers prompt iteration, not dataset-based evaluation.

support.subject: As an ML engineer, I can curate datasets from production traces and run offline evaluations against them
